hero.heading: Growing Global Careers in
hero.description: GreenRoot connects aspiring Indian agricultural students with world-class international internships, practical training, and career opportunities — empowering the next generation of agri-professionals.

images.mainAlt: Students learning in an agricultural field

story.heading: Tracing our roots from a local startup to a global platform.
story.description: GreenRoot began with a belief that Indian agriculture students deserve the same global opportunities as students in other fields.

chapters.title: Our Mission
chapters.label: Mission
chapters.body: To empower agriculture students by providing access to trusted international internships that foster learning, innovation, and meaningful career growth.

chapters.title: Our Vision
chapters.label: Vision
chapters.body: To become the world's most trusted platform connecting future agri-professionals with global opportunities and industry-leading organisations.

chapters.title: Our Promise
chapters.label: Promise
chapters.body: Every internship listed on GreenRoot is carefully curated to ensure transparency, quality, and a genuinely valuable real-world experience for every student.
